verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a REST API and TypeScript SDK for launching and interacting with agents. It has bearer-token authentication docs and API keys with assignable roles, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.omnara.com/openapi.json. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.
Omnara provides an **API**, **Typescript SDK**, and **CLI** to interact with Omnara
Send either key as a bearer token.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.omnara.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
